title: TT-ESCO: exact structured-coalescent likelihoods with tensor trains (code, benchmarks and data)
description: Code, benchmark results and input data for 'Exact structured-coalescent likelihoods beyond the full state space with tensor trains' (Hael Song). Tensor-train (tt/) and full-vector (dense/) implementations of the exact structured-coalescent likelihood on a fixed time tree, a converged MASCOT implementation (approx/), the escott package (pkg/), simulators, all benchmark scripts and result tables (bench/), and the figure scripts (paper/figures/).

creators.name: Song, Hael
creators.affiliation: Korea University, Seoul, Republic of Korea
